A consultant of the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) inspected the landslip sites along the Mettupalayam-Udhagamandalam Road via Coonoor on Wednesday (October 28, 2026) as traffic remains suspended partially along the ghat section since October 24.
Sources said the consultant from Uttarakhand, who is specialised in analysing hilly terrains, inspected places where landslips occurred along the ghat section. The consultant is expected to submit a report to the Regional Officer, MoRTH, Chennai, in a few days, they said.
Landslips were reported at 25 places along the road, including a major one at Burliyar that caught a TNSTC bus under the debris on the intervening nights of October 23 and October 24. While the driver of the bus was killed, its conductor suffered injuries.
According to sources from the State Highways Department (NH wing), damages to the road and embankment have been reported at several places, requiring correction. Additionally, large boulders that are prone to fall remain atop the landslip site at Burliyar. Traffic along the Mettupalayam-Burliyar-Katteri stretch of the ghat section remains suspended due to these damages and the threat of further potential fall of boulders at Burliyar.
